maps.name: Hollowmere
maps.description: The last village on the dragon's road. Slate roofs, shuttered windows, a chapel bell that still rings the dusk. Hollowmere has stood here since before the Auric Throne fell, and most of its folk would rather die in their gardens than be driven out by a wyrm.

maps.name: Mira Hask's Provisions
maps.description: Hollowmere's general store — torches, lockpicks, healing herbs, and whatever Mira talked the last caravan out of before it turned back south. The shelves are thinner every week the dragon stays in the sky.

maps.name: Orin's Forge
maps.description: Orin the Smith's crossroads forge, smoke rising day and night. The anvil is old campaign steel; the prices are honest; the smith's left hand is missing two fingers and the goblin who took them is dead.
